text: Let's talk about that genius comedy based on workplace life in Slough.
zh: 我们来聊聊那部以斯劳职场生活为背景的天才喜剧吧。
zh_hant: 我們來聊聊那部以斯勞職場生活為背景的天才喜劇吧。

text: Awkward moments, cringeworthy behaviour, infamous dance routines.
zh: 尴尬时刻、令人难堪的行为、出名的舞蹈动作。
zh_hant: 尷尬時刻、令人難堪的行為、出名的舞蹈動作。

text: 25 years since it first aired,
zh: 距离它首次播出已经25年了，
zh_hant: 距離它首次播出已經25年了，

text: the hit BBC sitcom The Office is now hailed as one of the all-time British greats.
zh: 这部英国广播公司热门情景喜剧《办公室》如今被誉为英国史上最伟大的作品之一。
zh_hant: 這部英國廣播公司熱門情景喜劇《辦公室》如今被譽為英國史上最偉大的作品之一。

text: Our reporter Graham Satchel has been hearing from some of the stars of the show,
zh: 我们的记者格雷厄姆·萨切尔采访了这部剧的一些主演，
zh_hant: 我們的記者格雷厄姆·薩切爾採訪了這部劇的一些主演，

text: which helped launch a number of Hollywood careers and a series of international spin-offs.

zh_hant: 這部劇幫助開啟了好萊塢的多段職業生涯，也催生了多部國際翻拍版。

text: The setting was desultory, the workplace humdrum,

zh_hant: 場景乏味，職場平淡無奇，

text: and the comedy groundbreaking.
zh: 而喜剧效果则是开创性的。
zh_hant: 而喜劇效果則是開創性的。

text: office introduced us to middle manager David Brent,
zh: 《办公室》向我们介绍了中层经理大卫·布伦特，
zh_hant: 《辦公室》向我們介紹了中層經理大衛·布倫特，

text: played by the co-creator of the show, Ricky Gervais.
zh: 由该剧联合创作者瑞奇·热维斯饰演。

text: What?

text: Yeah.

text: I'd say, at one time or another, every bloke in the office has woken up at the crack of dawn.

text: What?

text: I hadn't ever worked in an office before,

text: That's the third time he's done it.

text: wasn't even funny the first time.

text: It's always you.

text: her to get away from this place.

text: has described your relationship with Tim

text: in The Office as one of the greatest romantic Stories of all time.

text: one tear just dropped."

Come on, trust me, you'll feel...
